profileStep.title: Who's planning today?
profileStep.description: Every profile gets its own home screen – clear for adults, playful for kids.

github.title: Built for families. Open to everyone.
github.subtitle: View the project, contribute, or leave a star.

hero.title: A shared rhythm for your family.
hero.description: Appointments, groceries, meals, chores and little moments of joy – in one calm place for every generation.

familyStep.title: Great to have you here.
familyStep.privateDescription: Enter your family name yourself. Other accounts on this server are no longer shown.
familyStep.registrationClosedDescription: Only the server operator can grant additional access.

familyTransfer.title: Bring your family along
familyTransfer.description: Restore the encrypted move file from your previous LX server here. This only works while no family has been created on this server yet.
familyTransfer.security: The file is only decrypted here on your new server.
familyTransfer.wrongFile: Please choose an LX move file.
familyTransfer.tooLarge: The move file is too large.
familyTransfer.success: The family has moved. LX is opening now.

step1.title: What's your family's name?
step1.description: The family name appears on the home screen. The password protects your private space.
step1.inviteRequired: An invitation code is required to create the family. Enter it above to continue.
step1.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters long before “Next” becomes available.
step1.privacyNote: The password is stored encrypted and never shown in the family overview.

step2.title: Give everyone a name and their position.
step2.description: Mom, Dad, child, Grandma, Grandpa and more: this automatically creates the right view and permissions.
step2.adminRequiredTitle: A profile with management rights is missing
step2.adminRequiredDescription: Choose at least one signed-in adult profile, such as Mom, Dad, Grandma, or Grandpa. This profile can add people and manage family settings later.
step2.adminReadyDescription: {{names}} can manage profiles and family settings.

step3.title: {{familyName}}, your family space is ready to go.
step3.description: Profiles, roles and privacy are set up. From now on you can add content together.
step3.childModeDescription: Kids see chores as adventures and collect stars.

footer.step2: Position and role can be changed later.
footer.step3: You can start planning right away.

releasePreview.afterLogin: Signed-in adult profiles also see these notes as a welcome message the first time they open the new version.
